question: GD 34 is related to HE 24 in a certain way. In the same way, CJ 12 is related to DK 2. To which of the given options is XV 56 related, following the same logic?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2670e84d57d8f3a0b32ba38d09d05a2c6cf49319e5d8eba39c7f1d3137f99525.png] 

The logic followed here is,

GD 34 is related to HE 24

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1c8341f80852d0db1795ddb5cd0a2da6161ea6813ec4b8c248dd9b29a2d74b7e.png] 

CJ 12 is related to DK 2

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e6f3df522dfd16bb68bfc2b3fc4e2e847b67aeedb0fd387dad9f9f82f6bddac8.png] 

Similarly, XV 56 is related to YW 46

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/12e72c60c6052f3f28bd7edcdd437d30d01b6ab4470bbf42f5c1c1c442e48010.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 2".**
